title: Vampire Vape Desserts Caramelised Banana Pancake E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: Caramelised Banana Pancake by Vampire Vape Desserts Koncept range delivers the rich taste of golden banana slices seared in syrupy sugar, layered over a warm, buttery pancake base. This dessert-inspired e-liquid captures the familiar comfort of a classic pancake stack, pairing smooth banana flavour with notes of caramelised glaze and subtle pastry notes. Blended at 70% VG to 30% PG, this high-VG shortfill is ideal for sub-ohm vaping, delivering dense vapour and a deeper, more rounded flavour experience. Supplied as 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 60ml bottle, there's space to add a 10ml nicotine shot to tailor the strength to your preference. Made in the UK to the highest standards, this flavour is part of Vampire Vape’s indulgent Desserts collection — a series of comforting sweet e-liquid blends crafted for vapers who enjoy rich, expertly layered profiles. Also available in Freebase 10mls and Concentrates for DIY e-liquid fans.
